member.name: T:EmberTrace.Abstractions.Attributes.TraceAttribute
member.summary: Marks a method or a class for automatic instrumentation by the EmberTrace source generator.
member.remarks: On a partial method declaration the generator emits the implementing part, which opens a scope and calls the …Core method holding the body. On a class it emits a Traced… decorator over the class's interface. Misuse is reported at build time: ETG010 when the method is not a partial declaration without a body, ETG011 when no compatible …Core member exists, ETG012 for unsupported shapes, ETG013 when a containing type is not partial, ETG014 when the interface of a class is ambiguous.

member.name: M:EmberTrace.Abstractions.Attributes.TraceAttribute.#ctor
member.summary: Traces the member under its default name, TypeName.MethodName.

member.name: M:EmberTrace.Abstractions.Attributes.TraceAttribute.#ctor(System.String)
member.summary: Traces the member under a fixed name that survives renames and new overloads.
member.param: The scope name. The id is the stable hash of this name unless is set.

member.name: P:EmberTrace.Abstractions.Attributes.TraceAttribute.Category
member.summary: The category of the scope. When the generator falls back to on the method, then on the containing types from the innermost outward.

member.name: P:EmberTrace.Abstractions.Attributes.TraceAttribute.Id
member.summary: An explicit scope id. 0, the default, means the id is the stable hash of the name, the same value Tracer.Id(name) returns.
member.remarks: An id declared more than once in an assembly is reported as ETG001.

member.name: P:EmberTrace.Abstractions.Attributes.TraceAttribute.Interface
member.summary: The interface the generated decorator implements, for an attribute applied to a class. Required only when the class implements more than one candidate interface; otherwise ETG014 is reported.

member.name: P:EmberTrace.Abstractions.Attributes.TraceAttribute.Name
member.summary: The fixed scope name, or when the default TypeName.MethodName is used.

member.name: T:EmberTrace.Abstractions.Attributes.TraceCategoryAttribute
member.summary: Assigns a category to a trace id declared as a const int field, or to the methods of a method, class or struct.
member.remarks: On a field that is not a const int the attribute is ignored and ETG005 is reported. An empty category is reported as ETG003.

member.name: M:EmberTrace.Abstractions.Attributes.TraceCategoryAttribute.#ctor(System.String)
member.param: The category name shown in reports and exports and used by category filters.

member.name: T:EmberTrace.Abstractions.Attributes.TraceIdAttribute
member.summary: Declares the name and category of a trace id for the whole assembly. The source generator collects every declaration into one metadata provider and registers it when the assembly loads.
member.remarks: Arguments that are not compile-time constants are reported as ETG004 and the declaration is skipped. A repeated id is ETG001, an empty name ETG002, an empty category ETG003.

The category of the id, or for none.

member.name: P:EmberTrace.Abstractions.Attributes.TraceIdAttribute.Category
member.summary: The category of the id, or for none.

member.name: P:EmberTrace.Abstractions.Attributes.TraceIdAttribute.Name
member.summary: The name shown for the id.

member.name: T:EmberTrace.Abstractions.Attributes.TraceNameAttribute
member.summary: Gives a display name to a trace id declared as a const int field. Without it the field name is used.
member.remarks: On a field that is not a const int the attribute is ignored and ETG005 is reported.
